They are designed to support DREAMS program implementors monitor performance in real time in a dynamic and interactive way. The Dashboards draws data from the client level DREAMS database and present it in simplified but informative charts and tables. The goal of the dashboards is to ease program monitoring by providing custom performance visuals and tables thereby reducing the need for repetitive analyses. Currently, the DREAMS dashboards are only available to the following DREAMS stakeholders; • DREAMS Implementing partners • USG agencies; CDC, DOD and USAID Types of DREAMS Dashboards Currently, there are three types of DREAMS Dashboards available for the users. These are: I. MER Dashboards-These dashboards are based on a beneficiary’s age at the end of the reporting period i.e. for the first half of the financial year (1st October -31st March), analysis will be based on a beneficiary’s age as at 31st March while for second half of the year (April- September), the analysis will be based on a beneficiary’s age as at 30th September of that year. This dashboard is ideal for DATIM reporting. II. Operational Dashboards-The beneficiary’s age on this dashboard is computed as at the date of access i.e. this varies each day. This dashboard is ideal for day to day program implementation support/decision making. NB: The key distinction between the two dashboards lies in the computation of current age. III. Frozen Dashboards: These are dashboards extracted from the MER dashboards and stored as at a specific date. Data uploaded in the database after the extraction (freeze) date will not reflect in the frozen dashboards (but will be available in the other two dashboards above). These dashboards serve the following main purposes: a. For SAPR/APR reporting. These will be frozen on the date when data was uploaded into DATIM e.g., during APR, the dashboards may be frozen on 30th September. Any data uploaded after that will not reflect here. b. As reference in the event of IP transitions: These dashboards will show the performance an IPs who transition out of DREAMS as at their last date of program implementation.
